title: The Confession

characters.Nishant: agency owner, late 30s, tired and guilty

setting: agency office at night, lit by laptop screen, rain on window

shots.action: Nishant's face lit blue by laptop, slowly closes it

lines.text: I've been lying to every client.

shots.action: Maya enters, switches on desk lamp

lines.text: Nishant... why are you still here?

shots.action: Nishant slides folder marked CONFIDENTIAL across desk

lines.text: Every campaign that worked. Every 'genius' idea...

shots.action: Pages flip: prompts labelled Client A, B, C

lines.text: It was Claude. These are the prompts.

shots.action: Maya pulls her own folder from bag, starts opening it
Nishant's hand slams her folder shut, thunder
Locked eyes, lamp flickers, rain intensifies, cut to black
shots.text: Some prompts should never be shown.
